listing.name: Pokémon Sapphire (Gen1Recomp / G1R Deluxe)
listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: Use upstream ROM import and player-prepared native runtime; game-specific integration remains research. Red #98 scope is separate. Limits: beta research; no inherited Red qualification or managed update/save ownership. Upstream platforms: The shared engine documents Windows x64, Linux x64, and macOS Intel/Apple Silicon host routes. Compatibility of current packages with this additional game remains research and is not inherited from the Red #98 qualification. Original data: Own canonical US English Sapphire ROM; exact accepted revisions and SHA-1 are listed in current upstream README. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
